serviceCapacity.source: flexcar.service_capacities for allocatedMin; each bucket's own table for bookedMin; service_capacities reserved columns carried as ledgerBookedMin
serviceCapacity.note: allocatedMin = modelled service minutes available for that bucket; bookedMin = authoritative load from the bucket's own table; ledgerBookedMin = service_capacities reserved, which lags intermittently and is kept only so the divergence stays visible; onFlexService.bookedMin is whole-job estimated minutes while its ledgerBookedMin is remaining minutes, so the two are not expected to agree; null means no service_capacities row, not zero capacity
